title: Wso2am: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an LDAP query ('LDAP injection') vulnerability in Legion…
description: An LDAP injection vulnerability exists in the wso2am package due to improper neutralization of special elements in LDAP queries. This flaw affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.5 and allows an attacker to potentially manipulate LDAP queries, impacting confidentiality and integrity without requiring privileges or user interaction. Fixed versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 are available.
